_WARNING: The CastMagic storyEvent below does NOT fire on normal player spell casts (in-game 2026-06-20) — the passive Cast Magic SM root is not broadcast for ordinary casts. For a WORKING cast-to-train trigger use examples/skill_cast_spec.json (a scripted magic effect -> MFStoryEventDispatch.Fire -> a ScriptEvent quest; in-game confirmed 2026-06-20: persist + perk sync + affinity gate all work, level climbs on recast). This spec is kept as a reference for the persist/syncPerks STRUCTURE and OnStory routing only.
_: Idea #20 in-world skill tree — Phase 0 (JContainers JFormDB persistence) with an EASY in-game trigger. CAST ANY SPELL to train: a CastMagic Story-Manager quest (MFSkill_Q) starts whenever the PLAYER casts a spell, and its OnStory handler banks Endurance skill state to a JFormDB storage keyed on the player, then syncs the Adaptation perk from the stored rank — no NPC to find, no dialogue. (An SM-started quest never runs its startUpStage fragment — in-game 2026-06-19 — so the persist runs in the OnStory<Event> handler instead; the generator routes it there automatically.) The AFFINITY GATE (design §四, Sofia F6 blueprint) wraps the bank+sync: growth only happens while MFSkill_Affinity >= 4, so the tester flips the gate by console (`set MFSkill_Affinity to 4`) and watches it turn on. ⚠ REQUIRES JContainers SE installed at runtime; compiling the generated MFSkill_Q_Stages.psc needs JContainers' own .psc on the Papyrus header path (main machine — see memory headless-jcontainers-papyrus-headers). Lifecycle: only the root-DB path API (JFormDB.solveXxxSetter/solveInt) is used, so there is no JValue.object()/retain()/release() to balance (design unknown U5, avoided by construction). The perk is a trivial inline PERK so the spec is self-contained; swap for your real skill-tree perks.

globals._: The affinity / relationship counter (Sofia F6 blueprint). In a real mod you'd raise it via gifts/quests; here the tester sets it by console to flip the gate. short = integer flag/counter.

perks.name: Adaptation
perks.description: Endurance node — the bearer endures and hits a touch harder.
perks._effect: A trivial self-contained entryPoint so the perk does something when synced; swap for your real node effect.

quests.name: Endurance Training
quests._: CastMagic Story-Manager quest. The engine's Cast Magic story event starts it whenever the player casts a spell (the GetIsID Player condition restricts the trigger to the player — without it every NPC cast would start the quest too). type=None keeps it out of the journal. No aliases: the persist is keyed on the player (Game.GetPlayer()), so nothing needs an event-filled alias (a required fromEvent alias would also block a console `startquest` test).

stages._: persist + syncPerks keyed on the PLAYER, both gated on MFSkill_Affinity >= 4. On each qualifying cast: bump Endurance level (+1) and ratio (+0.25) as delta counters, set the Adaptation node to rank 2, then sync — Adaptation is added once its stored rank reaches 2. The stage carries the spec; the OnStory<Event> handler runs it (an SM quest's startUpStage fragment never fires).

storyEvent._: Fires when the player casts any spell. The condition restricts it to the player (GetIsID == Player, Skyrim.esm:0x00000014); the Cast Magic event's subject is the casting actor.
